purpose: Audit missing mutually exclusive source-grounded readings without manufacturing decoder contrast.

limits.reason: Inherited bounded exact-search interface; this augmentation holds the seven source anchors fixed to isolate added readings. Maxima are compute/representation limits, never a coverage target.

source_priority: No reliability or document-priority hierarchy is assumed; each reading concerns what its own source asserts.
proposal_gate_order: strict audit shape and complete unique mention coverage
source hashes and exact unique quote alignment
primary-source anchor overlap for every proposed reading
unchanged v06 schema and temporal modality gates
source-only adjudication of both support and mutual exclusion
full candidate graph and correction-policy validation

adjudication.trigger: any proposal or representation defect; no separate adjudication is needed when audit proposes nothing and flags no defects
adjudication.reviewer: a fresh source-only review context, with the same declared source context, base graph, audit output and this protocol; no scores or answers
adjudication.decision_evidence: exact source quotes plus concise support and mutual-exclusion rationale; schema validation is not entailment adjudication
adjudication.uncertain_disposition: unresolved proposals are recorded but not admitted
adjudication.disagreement: record both findings; no repeated model votes or outcome-based tie breaking
adjudication.defect_policy: unresolved base-graph representation defects block augmentation; a corrected graph would require its own explicit repair protocol and must not silently replace this base
adjudication.not_claimed: human validation, independent model family, immutable model revision, gold standard

semantic_deduplication.reason_for_exclusion: IDs, provenance/description, precision labels and observation_kind do not create a new represented core claim when endpoint bounds and observations are identical.
semantic_deduplication.normalization: Exact field strings retained; no stemming, alias collapse, lowercasing or date shifts. JSON canonicalization uses sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False; unknown bounds remain null.
semantic_deduplication.representative: An existing base candidate wins any duplicate. Otherwise lexicographically smallest SHA256 of full canonical proposed reading without candidate_id wins; hash collision fails.
semantic_deduplication.evidence: Do not rewrite the retained base record. Store additional duplicate provenance in the lineage ledger. For new equivalent proposals, keep representative bytes and record all duplicates separately.
semantic_deduplication.subsumption: Overlapping or nested readings are not exact duplicates. They require semantic adjudication; never admit them as mutually exclusive solely because JSON differs.

union.base: Preserve existing mentions, reading order, links, aliases, authorities, dependencies and unsupported records unchanged.
union.new_readings: Accepted nonduplicate proposals appended in each existing mention by semantic-key SHA256; canonical IDs a07_ plus full semantic-key SHA256 (including mention_id). ID collisions fail.
union.links: No automatic clone from existing readings. Only separately accepted source-supported proposed links are added; substitute canonical candidate IDs. Deduplicate on relation,endpoints and correction certificate, retaining existing link if identical. New link IDs al07_ plus full canonical semantic-link SHA256; hash/order deterministically.
union.lineage: Record temporary-to-canonical IDs, accepted/rejected/unresolved decisions, semantic duplicates, exact context hashes and before/after graph hashes.
union.zero_additions: Keep base graph identity; report ambiguity audit found no admitted extra readings. Do not advertise a competing-reading evaluation.
union.hard_failure: Any overflow, malformed candidate, unresolved base defect or final validation failure blocks scoring this augmented graph. Preserve raw failures; no score-driven repair.

known_design_limitations: Manual development case and earlier extraction output visible to auditor.
Auditor is encouraged to scrutinize alternatives, so it is not a blind fresh extraction.
Context isolation does not eliminate pretraining knowledge or shared model biases.
One audit cannot establish completeness or an absence of source ambiguity.
This protocol does not by itself supply evidence of joint-decoding value.
